intro: Red Wool Bandanas are makeshift symbols fashioned by imprisoned Defias cutthroats inside the Stormwind Stockade. Torn from jailhouse wool blankets, they serve as defiant emblems of brotherhood even behind bars.

p: Even locked deep within the high stone walls of the Stormwind Stockade, members of the Defias Brotherhood refuse to surrender their identity. Using scraps torn from prison wool blankets, inmates secretly craft red bandanas to wear as identifying colors. To the guards, these scarves are contraband that spark fatal mutinies; to the prisoners, they are a statement that their brotherhood and rebellion endure, even in chains.

The bandanas gained a bitter notoriety after fourteen-year-old prison guard Mac Raskol caught inmates shredding blankets to make them. When he attempted to discipline the prisoners, the Defias convicts stabbed him in the back. In the wake of his death, his grieving grandmother Nikova seeks out adventurers to venture into the rioting dungeon, cull the rioters, and retrieve the crimson cloth as proof of vengeance.
